body.name: Common-pattern then partition sampler
body.construction: Given the realized \(Z\), \(\mathsf{Sample}_{ZP}\) first draws \(z\) uniformly from \(H(a,b)\); independently on each market side it uniformly permutes treated labels into the indexed blocks with \(z_\ell=1\) and control labels into the indexed blocks with \(z_\ell=0\), cuts at the prescribed sizes, and reports only the resulting paired partition \(P\).
